thread:
jordan: kicking off onboarding for llamaX-7b into dedicated pool. moved weights to s3://redwood-dedicated/weights/llamaX/7b/v1. noticed tokenizer is automatically adding <s> at start and </s> at end even when our chat template already emits role sentinels — results in +1 token in a few prompts. anyone seen this with sentencepiece chat models? :thinking:
maria: can you paste the tokenizer.json and a short example that reproduces the extra token?
jordan: it's sentencepiece. tokenizer.json excerpt:
```
{
  "model_type": "sentencepiece",
  "bos_id": 11,
  "eos_id": 12,
  "pad_id": 0,
  "special_tokens_map": {"<|user|>":65531, "<|assistant|>":65532}
}
```
example prompt:
system: "You are a concise summarizer."
user: "Summarize X"
chat_template: ["<|system|>", "<|user|>"]
encoded -> [<s>, <|system|>, ..., </s>]  // extra leading <s> observed
luis: heads-up: those special token ids are in the 655xx range which collides with the quant runtime's reserved sentinel window (60000-66000) on some older kernels. we've had silent failures where lazy remap + kernel sentinel overlap caused bad cache keys.
maria: we should remap during onboarding but do it with an explicit version so KV cache/versioning isn't broken. pseudocode idea:
```
if special_ids overlap reserved_range:
  remap = compute_new_ids(base=70000)
  write_new_vocab(remap)
  set model_config.token_id_map_version = "v1-remap"
```
sam: also need a guard for chat templates w/ role tokens so we don't double-insert BOS. propose a config flag `strip_bos_for_role_tokens` default false and enabled for chat-style models where role sentinels exist.
jordan: opened PR 671 with remap script + unit tests and a regtest that reproduces the bos/eos double-count. moved weights path in the onboarding manifest as well. pinging @sam for review and @infra-bot for pipeline validation.
sam: will review. can you paste the regtest repro? want a concise failing case to include in changelog.
jordan: regtest snippet:
```
context: system="You are a helpful assistant"
user="List steps"
chat_template=["<|system|>","<|user|>"]
encode(context) -> [<s>, <|system|>, ..., </s>]  // observed
expected -> [<|system|>, ..., </s>]  // no leading <s> since role token starts the chat
```
maria: small patch: when request_text startswith '<|' and first token == bos_id then strip leading bos. but gate by the config flag so non-chat models keep old behavior.
luis: agree. also leave a comment referencing kernel bug so future reviewers know why remap exists (kernel-bug#923).
infra-bot: onboarding pipeline updated: 1) verify weights path exists and size > 1GB; 2) match tokenizer.json sha256 to manifest; 3) assert special token ids not in reserved ranges (pad 0-1023, kernel reserved 60000-66000). pipeline: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/onboard/llamaX-7b/671
deploy-bot: scheduled staging deploy for dedicated pool: 2026-04-02 03:30 UTC.
eng-runtime: merged runtime fix for sentinel handling in quant kernels (PR 114). will publish an RC artifact for canary validation: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/rc/eng-runtime/114
sam: left two small nits on the PR and requested a changelog entry explaining token_id remap + strip_bos flag. once infra checks are green i'll approve. :+1:
jordan: updated onboarding checklist and README with `token_id_map_version` and `strip_bos_for_role_tokens`. maria said she'll run the smoke locally and paste logs if anything fails.
maria: running smoke now, will post results. if green i'll mark PR ready to merge.
